dreamteamer.title: Meetings
dreamteamer.description: Your calendar meetings as records: synced from Google Calendar (`/fetch-meetings`), with attendees as `contacts`, the company as `companies` and your own people in the room as `users` (`ours`). Files screenshots taken during a call beside its meeting (`/fetch-meeting-screenshots`) and stamps each attendee's contact with their latest meeting (`/update-contacts-from-meetings`).
